ar: نصحت صاحبي يكمل الدراسة
en: I advised my friend to finish his studies.

ar: ما نصحتش خويا البارح
en: I didn't advise my brother yesterday.

ar: نصحتي خوك يقرا بزاف
en: You (m.) advised your brother to read a lot.

lat: ma nse7tish sa7bek qbel ma ykhrej
ar: ما نصحتيش صاحبك قبل ما يخرج
en: You (m.) didn't advise your friend before he left.

ar: نصحتي مك تنعس شوية
en: You (f.) advised your mother to sleep a bit.

lat: ma nse7tish sa7btek 7it ma bghatsh tsme3
ar: ما نصحتيش صاحبتك حيت ما بغاتش تسمع
en: You (f.) didn't advise your friend because she didn't want to listen.

lat: l-mu3allim nse7 t-tlamdha yqrau kul nhar
ar: المعلم نصح التلامذة يقراو كل نهار
en: The teacher advised the students to study every day.

lat: bba ma nse7sh khuya yshri t-tumubil
ar: بابا ما نصحش خويا يشري الطوموبيل
en: Dad didn't advise my brother to buy the car.

ar: ماما نصحات خويا يزور جدي
en: Mom advised my brother to visit my grandfather.

ar: ما نصحاتش ولدها حيت كانت عيانة
en: She didn't advise her son because she was tired.

ar: نصحنا جارنا يبيع الدار
en: We advised our neighbor to sell the house.

lat: ma nse7nash l-mudir 7it huwa kay3ref kolshi
ar: ما نصحناش المدير حيت هو كيعرف كلشي
en: We didn't advise the manager because he knows everything.

ar: نصحتو ختكم تمشي عند الطبيب
en: You (pl.) advised your sister to go to the doctor.

lat: ma nse7tush weldkum qbel ma ysafer
ar: ما نصحتوش ولدكم قبل ما يسافر
en: You (pl.) didn't advise your son before he traveled.

lat: jirani nes7u bba ybqa f had l-7ayy
ar: جيراني نصحو بابا يبقى فهاد الحي
en: My neighbors advised my dad to stay in this neighborhood.

ar: ما نصحوش خويا كانو مشغولين
en: They didn't advise my brother; they were busy.

ar: كننصح ولدي يكون صادق ديما
en: I advise my son to always be honest.

ar: ما كننصحش صاحبي فهادشي
en: I don't advise my friend about this.

ar: كتنصح صحابك ديما بالخير
en: You (m.) always advise your friends well.

lat: ma katnse7sh khuk, kay3ref shnu kaydir
ar: ما كتنصحش خوك كيعرف شنو كيدير
en: You (m.) don't advise your brother; he knows what he's doing.

ar: كتنصحي بنتي تجي بكري
en: You (f.) advise your daughter to come early.

ar: ما كتنصحيش ختك حيت هي كبيرة عليك
en: You (f.) don't advise your sister because she's older than you.

lat: t-tbib kaynse7 n-nas yshrbu l-ma bezzaf
ar: الطبيب كينصح الناس يشربو الما بزاف
en: The doctor advises people to drink a lot of water.

lat: bba ma kaynse7sh bezzaf, kaybqa sakit
ar: بابا ما كينصحش بزاف كيبقى ساكت
en: Dad doesn't advise much; he stays quiet.

lat: mama katnse7 khti tshri l-khodra mn s-suq
ar: ماما كتنصح ختي تشري الخضرة من السوق
en: Mom advises my sister to buy vegetables from the market.

lat: jarti ma katnse7sh sa7btha f had l-mawdu3
ar: جارتي ما كتنصحش صاحبتها فهاد الموضوع
en: My neighbor (f.) doesn't advise her friend about this matter.

ar: كننصحو بعضنا فكلشي
en: We advise each other about everything.

ar: ما كننصحوش الناس فحياتهم
en: We don't advise people about their lives.

ar: كتنصحو الولاد ديالكم يقراو مزيان
en: You (pl.) advise your kids to study well.

lat: ma katnes7ush l-wlad dyalkum bla sabab
ar: ما كتنصحوش الولاد ديالكم بلا سبب
en: You (pl.) don't advise your kids for no reason.

ar: صحابي كينصحو خويا يدير الرياضة
en: My friends advise my brother to exercise.

ar: ما كينصحوش بابا حيت كيخافو منو
en: They don't advise Dad because they're afraid of him.

lat: ghadi nnse7 khuya ybqa f l-maghrib
ar: غادي ننصح خويا يبقى فالمغرب
en: I'm going to advise my brother to stay in Morocco.

lat: ma ghadish nnse7 jari 7it ma kaysme3sh
ar: ما غاديش ننصح جاري حيت ما كيسمعش
en: I'm not going to advise my neighbor because he doesn't listen.

lat: ghadi tnse7 khuk ybqa f l-medrasa
ar: غادي تنصح خوك يبقى فالمدرسة
en: You (m.) will advise your brother to stay in school.

lat: ma ghadish tnse7 jeddtek, hiya kat3ref mzyan
ar: ما غاديش تنصح جدتك هي كتعرف مزيان
en: You (m.) won't advise your grandmother; she knows well.

ar: غادي تنصحي صاحبتك تدخل الجامعة
en: You (f.) will advise your friend to go to university.

lat: ma ghadish tnes7i jaratek 7ta tfhemi shnu waqe3
ar: ما غاديش تنصحي جارتك حتى تفهمي شنو وقع
en: You (f.) won't advise your neighbor until you understand what happened.

lat: bba ghadi ynse7 khuya ysafer l faransa
ar: بابا غادي ينصح خويا يسافر لفرنسا
en: Dad is going to advise my brother to travel to France.

lat: l-mudir ma ghadish ynse7 l-khddama ghedda
ar: المدير ما غاديش ينصح الخدامة غدا
en: The manager won't advise the workers tomorrow.

lat: khalti ghadi tnse7 weldi ykhdem f l-bank
ar: خالتي غادي تنصح ولدي يخدم فالبنك
en: My aunt is going to advise my son to work at the bank.

lat: ma ghadish tnse7 khuya 7it ma 3ndha waqt
ar: ما غاديش تنصح خويا حيت ما عندها وقت
en: She won't advise my brother because she has no time.

ar: غادي ننصحو جدنا يشوف الطبيب
en: We're going to advise our grandfather to see the doctor.

ar: ما غاديش ننصحو حد غدا
en: We won't advise anyone tomorrow.

ar: غادي تنصحو صحابكم يخدمو مزيان
en: You (pl.) will advise your friends to work well.

lat: ma ghadish tnes7u jirankum f had l-qadiya
ar: ما غاديش تنصحو جيرانكم فهاد القضية
en: You (pl.) won't advise your neighbors in this matter.

ar: غادي ينصحو جارهم يبيع الطوموبيل
en: They are going to advise their neighbor to sell the car.

ar: ما غاديش ينصحو صاحبهم هو عاقل
en: They won't advise their friend; he's sensible.
